violations.why: irq_raptor (higher priority) can preempt glacier between its write and later read of v_fern and overwrite it.
raptor preempts glacier after it writes v_velvet and changes the value before it is read.
raptor can write v_lantern between the two reads in fn_orchid (called from glacier), so they see different values.
raptor can write v_ember between the two consecutive reads in fn_orchid.
raptor preempts willow and overwrites v_velvet before willow reads it.
raptor overwrites v_upland between willow's write and later read.
raptor writes v_husk[K_ZINC1] between willow's write and read of the same element.
raptor preempts urchin and overwrites v_velvet before it is read.
raptor overwrites v_beacon between urchin's write and later read.
